title: The Contact of the DMZ
author: Hazel Marchetti
blurb: Hazel Villalobos, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
